import pixeltable as pxt
from pixeltable.functions.huggingface import sentence_transformer

docs = pxt.get_table('docs')

docs.add_embedding_index(
    'content',
    string_embed=sentence_transformer.using(model_id='all-MiniLM-L6-v2'),
)

sim = docs.content.similarity('climate change policy')
results = (
    docs.order_by(sim, asc=False)
    .select(docs.content, similarity=sim)
    .limit(5)
    .collect()
)

print(results)

import pixeltable as pxt

    'content',
